shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,280p' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,180p' app/layout.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files app lib'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '320,480p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('transition'))); console.log(require('next/package.json').version)\" && rg -n \"ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head && rg -n '\"react\"|\"react-dom\"|\"next\"' package.json | head -30 && node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').peerDependencies)\""
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view react version && npm view react@canary version && npm view react-dom version'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css package.json package-lock.json && git status --short && node -e \"console.log(require('react/package.json').version, require('react-dom/package.json').version)\""
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' lib/products.ts && git diff --check && git status --short && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && wc -c tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && head -c 100 tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && node -e \"console.log('ViewTransition export:', typeof require('react').ViewTransition)\" && git diff --check"
